europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Resume in Kyiv
europe_now.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes have resumed against the Ukrainian capital following a brief three-day pause, resulting in at least two reported fatalities. Emergency services and local authorities are responding to the renewed bombardment as air raid alerts remain active across the region.

europe_now.title: German Political Fallout Over Far-Right Success
europe_now.summary: Political leaders in Germany are grappling with the fallout from a major far-right electoral breakthrough that has triggered widespread debate regarding stability and governance. Observers note that mainstream parties face mounting pressure as they attempt to formulate effective strategies in response to shifting voter alignments.

top_stories.title: French AI Sector Funding Milestone
top_stories.summary: French artificial intelligence startup Mistral has achieved a significant valuation milestone of 21 billion euros following its latest capital-raising round. The substantial investment highlights the growing economic and technological prominence of European firms within the global artificial intelligence landscape.

top_stories.title: Labor Dispute Closes Eiffel Tower
top_stories.summary: Staff members at the Eiffel Tower initiated a strike action that forced the closure of the landmark monument in Paris. The walkout was organized by workers following a dispute regarding the reassignment of female staff members for a specific group visit.
